name: Dev Tools
description: Sandboxed, offline — 40 tools at ~100KB, one permission (local UI-state storage): generators (password/QR/barcode/ID/RSA/TOTP/placeholder), codecs (Base64/Base58/URL/escape/punycode/data-URI), crypto (hash/HMAC/JWT/AES/certificate), text tools (JSON/diff/regex/lines/mojibake) and more.
releaseNotes: 40 tools: password/ID/lorem/QR/barcode/RSA/TOTP/placeholder generators, Base64/32/58/URL/escape/punycode/quoted-printable/data-URI/image codecs, image compressor, hash & HMAC & CRC32, JWT decode & sign, AES, certificate decoder, RMB uppercase, JSON formatter, text diff, regex tester, case/line/invisible-char/mojibake tools, timestamp & date calc & duration, cron expression, SQL IN builder, Unicode inspector, file size, number base, semver, IP calculator, color & contrast & CMYK, chmod. Per-tool state persistence, favorites and recently-used (host.storage).
